name: scheduler

test_list.description: Merge ordinary and reserved cancellation queues by sequence.
Enforce 1024 records, 2 MiB payload, 256 events and 4 ms deadline.
Do not schedule clean frames; cap dirty frames to 60 fps.
Accept cancellation beyond ordinary queue capacity, reject additional ordinary records, and retain cross-lane sequence.
Reject retained paste payload above 2 MiB and stop a batch at the 4 ms deadline.
Replace only adjacent Resize events with the latest dimensions.
Coalesce adjacent Moved events while preserving mouse drag and other semantic barriers.
Ensure keys, paste, wheel, drag, resize, and reserved cancellation events prevent mouse-move coalescing across them.

output_description: Bounded ordered event batch and demand-frame scheduling.
